scope: Rendered final-pack fixtures, not a complete campaign or OS-mouse playthrough

interventions.battle_access: preceding rooms marked cleared, target entered through Actions.enter_room
interventions.crew: starter equipment; fixture crew levels set relative to location
interventions.discovery: all places visited, all regions unlocked, trial prerequisites supplied
interventions.hulls: Actions.rebuild_decks; furnished test layouts and assigned workers
interventions.travel: direct isolated fixture placement, not voyage/cost validation
interventions.weather_time: explicit Weather.forced and fixture game clock

coverage.scope: Native fullscreen shipped-PCK presentation fixtures; no organic completion or OS mouse claim
